newsitem.title: UK: UK-US "open skies" talks to resume next week.
newsitem.headline: UK-US "open skies" talks to resume next week.

text.p: Britain said on Wednesday that it is to resume "open skies" trade talks with the United States on November 6 in Washington at the request of the U.S., which broke off negotiations three months ago.
UK-US open skies talks to resume next week =2
An official at the UK Department of Transport said its negotiators would be meeting their U.S. counterparts for a two-day session in Washington on November 6-7.
"They are taking place at the US's request following informal contacts after the last round of talks (in August) was cancelled," he said.

The fresh attempt at agreeing an "open skies" deal began in July after British Airways and American Airlines urged the governments to free up competition as a necessary condition for approving their controversial plans to join forces on the transatlantic market.
